source_text: Since 2007, the World Health Organization has endorsed voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) in 15 eastern and southern African countries with high HIV prevalence, following randomized controlled trials showing approximately 60% reduction in men's risk of acquiring HIV from heterosexual sex.
